turns.prompt: Build a landing page for Oyo Seed Fund, where farmers' cooperatives in Oyo pool G$ to buy seed and fertiliser. Match the design in my screenshot.
turns.context: context: 22 of 22 files in full (App.tsx, index.html, index.ts, package.json, index.ts, ConnectButton.tsx, badge.tsx, button.tsx, card.tsx, input.tsx, label.tsx, notice.tsx, skeleton.tsx, textarea.tsx, chain.ts, format.ts, hooks.ts, tokens.ts, useWallet.ts, utils.ts, main.tsx, styles.css)
turns.reply: I built the Oyo Seed Fund landing page as a single editorial page, matching your reference's structure and feel: black nav bar with a lime "Connect wallet" pill, cream split hero with the big serif headline and a sage circle panel, a dark stats band with lime numbers, the three numbered Pool/Vote/Grow cards, a lime CTA band, plus an about section and FAQ. The palette, Fraunces serif headings and rounded pill buttons come from your screenshot; the copy is Oyo Seed Fund's own, and the stats (12,400 G$ pooled, 38 farmers, 6 plots) and the member quote are labelled sample content for you to replace with real figures. There's no contract yet — "Start funding" and "Join the fund" simply connect the wallet.
